spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). A faded, slightly overexposed old snapshot from his university days, with a white instant-photo border: the man from the model sheet about ten years younger, around twenty, grinning at the camera, wearing a plain department T-shirt with a blank print area, standing in front of a campus building with trees. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
